web_search.radient.detail: Tavily search through your Radient account, $0.01 per search from your credits; sign in with `local-operator login radient`
web_search.radient.credits_low: Your Radient credit balance is too low for search. Add credits in the Radient Console; Radient search is retried within 5 minutes.
web_search.radient.sign_in_again: Radient refused your sign-in. Run `local-operator login radient` to sign in again.
web_search.radient.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to Radient. Run `local-operator login radient`.
web_search.meaning.auto_radient: tried after the free and native legs; billed to your Radient credits
web_search.meaning.radient_refused: skipped until you add credits; Radient is retried within 5 minutes
web_search.meaning.auto_native_plan: your model plan's built-in search, tried after the free legs
web_search.meaning.auto_native_paid: your model API key's built-in search, billed per search
web_search.meaning.auto_free_then_key: free tier first; your API key is tried after Radient
